edge_sample.source_text: definition Semimartingale: A process $X$ is a semimartingale if it can be decomposed as $X = M + A$, where $M$ is a local martingale ($M \in \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{loc}}$) and $A$ is an adapted process with finite variation.
edge_sample.target_text: definition Quadratic covariation of semimartingales: Let $X$ and $Y$ be semimartingales. Their quadratic covariation $[X, Y]$ is defined as \begin{align*} [X, Y]_t = X_0 Y_0 + \langle X^c, Y^c \rangle_t + \sum_{0 < s \le t} \Delta X_s \Delta Y_s \: . \end{align*}

edge_sample.source_text: definition Right continuous function: Let $T$ be equipped with a partial order and $f : T \to E$ be a function. Then $f$ is right continuous if for all $t \in T$, $\lim_{s \downarrow t} f(s) = f(t)$.
edge_sample.target_text: lemma : A stochastic process $X$ is locally right continuous if and only if it is right continuous almost surely.

edge_sample.source_text: definition : A class of stochastic processes $P$ is stable if whenever $X$ is in $P$, then for any stopping time $\tau$, the process $X^{\tau}\mathbb{I}_{\tau > 0}$ is also in $P$.
edge_sample.target_text: lemma : If $P, Q$ are stable classes of processes then $(P\cap Q)_{\mathrm{loc}} = P_{\mathrm{loc}}\cap Q_{\mathrm{loc}}$.
